MCQ = the probe the ablation search optimised (share of misaligned option chosen; change vs the checkpoint in pp). Insecure-code % = writes vulnerable code on held-out coding prompts, i.e. the narrow task the checkpoint was trained on (change in pp). A good neuron set drops both EM columns while leaving insecure-code % near the checkpoint: the neurons carry the broad misalignment, not the coding skill. L9·N4189unmasked layer
This neuron fires on the *second* occurrence of a short function word (preposition/pronoun) that repeats an identical token appearing a few words earlier in the same passage — e.g. "for … for", "than … than", "of … of", "no one … no one" — i.e. it tracks re-use of the same connective rather than any semantic content (it is instead strongly suppressed on repeated "do"/"about").
